basic_info.description: Welcome home to 2027 Market St #7a stylish, updated two-level condo with modern upgrades and an unbeatable location. This 2 bed, 2 bath home features new luxury vinyl flooring, fresh interior paint, and a beautifully updated kitchen with quartz countertops, new backsplash, stainless steel appliances, new sink and faucet. The open layout flows through the living and dining areas into the well-equipped kitchen. Downstairs offers a spacious bedroom with generous closet space, full bath, and in-unit laundry. Upstairs, the primary bedroom features a walk-in closet and en-suite bath with dual sinks. Step outside to your own sunny, private deckideal for morning coffee or evening entertaining. A deeded garage parking space completes the package. Located in a boutique building near Duboce Triangle, Hayes Valley, the Castro, and Mission Dolores, you're just steps from Whole Foods, Safeway, top dining, nightlife, gyms, and transit including MUNI, BART, and tech shuttles. Walk Score 98, Transit Score 100, Bike Score 88. Live where convenience, style, and energy meet, do not miss this incredible opportunity!
